name: Disposable Cloud Environment (DCE) Account Vending
description: End-to-end on-demand AWS account provisioning system: API Gateway triggers a Lambda that kicks off a Step Functions workflow, with lease and state managed in DynamoDB across a pool of 25 accounts, including automated per-account budget monitoring and reclamation — removing manual account provisioning from the team's critical path.

name: Org-Wide Identity & Access Infrastructure
description: Migrated AWS IAM Identity Center permission set provisioning from manual CloudFormation StackSets to Terraform deployed via Jenkins; manages Service Control Policies at the OU level and administers CyberArk privileged access (SIA, SCA) for least-privilege governance across the organization.

name: AIMS — AMI Governance & Compliance Platform
description: Fully serverless governance platform (S3/CloudFront front end, API Gateway routed to Lambda, ECS-hosted backend, Lambda-gated database access) that enforces AMI compliance in real time across every AWS account in the organization. CloudTrail instance-launch events stream through a central event bus and SQS queue to a Python Lambda that validates the AMI against an approved list, automatically stopping non-compliant instances via a cross-account role.

name: Enterprise EKS Platform at Scale
description: Built and operates Amazon EKS clusters at enterprise scale (3,000+ nodes), providing the compute substrate that product teams deploy onto without owning cluster operations themselves.

name: Self-Service CI/CD Platform
description: Built a self-service CI/CD platform (Jenkins, Bitbucket/GitHub) enabling 50+ automated deployments per month and cutting release cycle time by 30%; led a migration from Bitbucket to GitHub, including a secure ECS-based cloning container for private-subnet repository access.

name: Platform Observability Architecture
description: Established observability architecture (Datadog, Grafana, Splunk) across the platform, cutting mean time to resolution (MTTR) by 20%.

name: Automated Image Lifecycle Management
description: Automated image lifecycle management (QCOW2 to AMI), reducing environment provisioning time from 2–3 days to under 1 hour. Recognized with an internal Excellence Award.

name: Cloud Cost Optimization Initiative
description: Drove a 50% reduction in AWS cloud costs through rightsizing, spot instance policy, and compute governance, funding capacity for further platform investment. Recognized with Senior Leadership Appreciation.

name: Enterprise Kubernetes Platform (Nagarro)
description: Designed and deployed scalable Kubernetes clusters for high-availability production workloads across multiple enterprise client accounts, with Terraform-based infrastructure automation for consistent, repeatable environment provisioning and centralized monitoring via Prometheus, Grafana, and CloudWatch.

name: CI/CD Pipeline Automation (GlobalLogic)
description: Built and maintained CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins; developed Python and Shell automation scripts for infrastructure provisioning, integrating infrastructure-as-code tooling and security protocols to safeguard cloud environments.
